Subject: QuietStart go-live: handoff, SOW & early ops asks

Team —

We closed QuietStart last week (RDW-2026-2176). Quick context so CS can pick up the baton:

- Product: embeddings + chat for clinician search; expected steady-state ~35 qps, peak 120 qps during batch ingestion windows.
- Contract highlights: 12-month term, auto-renew, Hosted API with VPC peering option (they signed the Dedicated add-on but want host first); committed spend $220k/yr.
- Security: SOC2 requested; they need a copy of our engineer-runbook and retention policy.

Attached: SOW v1, the mutual action plan spreadsheet (MAP) and our initial network requirements doc. Please review the MAP column "owner" and confirm assignments.

Immediate asks:
1) Sofia — can you own the kickoff with QuietStart and run the first 30/60/90 acceptance milestones? Proposed kickoff: Aug 3, 10am PT.
2) Karthik — we need a tech intake and seq-length distribution review; they do a lot of short queries plus long clinical notes.
3) Monica — procurement will loop you for invoicing cadence and the carveouts on their PO.

I'll introduce the QuietStart contacts after you confirm times.

Thanks —
Jordan

Sounds good — I'll take owner for kickoff and the 30/60 acceptance flow. Proposed plan in brief:

- Aug 3, 10:00am PT — internal prep (Redwood ops + quietstart pre-call)
- Aug 4, 9:30am PT — customer kickoff (60 min): agenda: goals, success metrics, roles, staging timeline, security checklist
- Aug 10 — first staging run with sample dataset; Karthik to triage perf/seq issues

Karthik — can you confirm availability the week of Aug 10 for the staging run and whether you want us to run a token-distribution sampling ahead of time? I'll share MAP updates after we align.

Monica — if procurement needs a COP/PO template, I can loop you into the intro.

I'll draft a short kickoff invite and a 1-pager for QuietStart leadership that spells out acceptance gates and the quick rollback plan.

Sofia

Thanks for the summary. Aug 4 at 9:30am PT works for us for the kickoff. A couple of items procurement and our engineering team flagged before kickoff:

- Procurement: can you confirm Redwood's invoice schedule and whether the Dedicated add-on billing starts on sign or on Dedicated activation?

Attached: updated MAP (owners column filled), a one-page kickoff summary, and the network doc with placeholders for IPs.
